description: Brutal Orchestra is a Turn-Based Roguelike Strategy Game. You died, someone killed you. You are in Purgatory and you will never escape. Make a deal with the "demon" Bosch and set off into Purgatory finding ​all manner of demented friends and foes on your quest to get petty revenge.
name: Brutal Orchestra

objectives.co_op_rules: Flip primary objectives equal to the # of players, everyone must complete a primary objective with the flipped secondary objective
objectives.versus_tertiary: Most money at end of run
